items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a continuous and almost cocontinuous functor gives a direct image on sheaves which commutes with pushouts and coequalizers, and more generally with finite connected colimits (statement lines 10246-10254). The proof is a complete computation: for a finite connected index category the presheaf colimit satisfies the hypotheses of the companion result because finite connected colimits of singletons are singletons (proof lines 10257-10269); and the author displays a chain of equalities moving the direct image through sheafification to the presheaf colimit and then identifying the result with the colimit of the direct images (proof lines 10270-10276). The non-formal content is the chain of identifications. The claim is H2: a structured computation with each input named.
